description:

Execution contract:
Follow the task dependencies and the phase priority in the rebuilt F025 plan. tasks.title: Reproduce the reliability failures on isolated fixtures
tasks.description:
Outcome: Reproducible baseline fixtures for the six reported failures and the new storage boundary.

Current implementation: Handoffs, rules, claims, read tracking and recommendation already exist. Reports identify unreliable behavior; previous fixture reports do not certify this checkout.

Implementation responsibility:
- Build isolated old-format fixtures for several handoffs, repeated resume reads, ignored conventions, nested detours, current-phase priority bias and duplicate capability creation.
- Capture real core/MCP/Pi/server outputs and exact revisions, including same-task races, source workspace inference and failed/incomplete replies.
- Record bytes, characters, tool calls and model tokens where available; define comparable small/large-plan and no-op fixtures for later regression.
- Add the descriptor-missing/incompatible, missing-HOME and per-project-server assumptions to the migration baseline without changing real data.

Acceptance and evidence:
- Each reported case has a reproducible input and an observable expected correction; uncertain causes stay explicit.
- Fixtures use mkdtemp and stop owned processes; no real project is migrated or dashboard auto-started.
- Measurements distinguish product scenarios from synthetic SQL primitives.

tasks.title: Define one shared next-work and context contract
tasks.description:
Outcome: One domain contract for identity, eligibility, context, phase continuity and revision-aware results.

Current implementation: Selection/read-order and adapter messages diverge. The accepted target is HOME SQLite behind a single application service, while current consumers still open JSON stores.

Implementation responsibility:
- Specify stable project/repository/workspace/caller/native-session/execution identities and the boundaries implemented by T489, the SQLite task and T490.
- Define owned active work and valid returns before globally ready feature -> phase -> task ordering. Preserve coherent phase work; no global task queue or automatic priority preemption.
- Define typed success/non-success, actual context delivery, retained-context restoration, role-aware API parity and source/target availability extension points.
- Map every baseline case to one implementation owner and define bounded mutation/resume/query/editor budgets with explicit continuation.

Acceptance and evidence:
- Core/MCP/Pi/server/UI can consume the same versioned result shapes.
- Dependency readiness is distinct from desired ordering and code/rationale relationships.
- Phase continuity does not add an unapproved global exclusive phase lock; the warning-only no-task guard remains.
